units.source_text: 这时，我突然感到一阵食欲袭卷上来，这太符合我原先的预想，反而使我产生了一种被背叛了似的感觉。

en.t: At that moment, I suddenly felt a wave of appetite sweep over me, and because it fit my earlier expectations so perfectly, it instead gave me the feeling that I had been betrayed.

units.source_text: 昨天吃剩下的夹馅面包和豆馅糯米饼放在衣兜里。

en.t: The stuffed bread and bean-paste rice cake left over from yesterday were in my pocket.

units.source_text: 我用工作服的下摆揩了揩濡湿了的手，就贪婪地吃了起来，却不知是什么味道。

en.t: I wiped my damp hands on the hem of my work clothes and began eating greedily, though I could not tell what it tasted like.

units.source_text: 味觉另当别论，我的胃叫唤，我慌忙把点心塞在嘴里。

en.t: Taste was another matter; my stomach was crying out, and I hurriedly stuffed the sweets into my mouth.

units.source_text: 我心急如焚，胸口激烈地跳动。

en.t: I was burning with impatience, and my chest was pounding violently.

units.source_text: 好不容易咽下去，掬水喝了几口。

en.t: After finally managing to swallow it, I scooped up water and drank a few mouthfuls.
